name: mirage
text: Both fixed in code, shipping in one release (tests running now). (1) 'Its ticker is missing' on every Kalshi bet: the engine's Kalshi list reached the phone without each outcome's Kalshi ticker; the codec now carries it, with a test. (2) Laggy after turning Kalshi scanning on: after an engine restart there are about 10 minutes with no Kalshi list from GitHub, and in that gap the phone scanned all of Kalshi itself. It now waits for the engine while the engine is alive and scans locally only if the engine is down. If it is still laggy once you have the new version, tell me and I'll profile the phone directly. I'll send the release link here.
